# Wellcome Collection

> > A free London museum and library exploring health, science, medicine, and human experience through exhibitions, collections, and public engagement.

Wellcome Collection is a leading cultural institution dedicated to challenging perspectives on health and wellbeing through art, science, and historical narratives. The museum offers accessible programming including exhibitions, events, guided tours, and digital collections, with a strong commitment to inclusivity through British Sign Language interpretation and audio descriptions.

## Core Information & Planning

- [Homepage](https://wellcomecollection.org): Homepage for Wellcome Collection, free London museum/library exploring health, science, medicine, life and art.
- [Visit us](https://wellcomecollection.org/visit-us): Visitor information for Wellcome Collection including location on Euston Road, hours, accessibility and facilities.
- [What's on](https://wellcomecollection.org/whats-on): Calendar of exhibitions, events, gallery tours and workshops at Wellcome Collection with accessibility options.
- [About us](https://wellcomecollection.org/about-us): About Wellcome Collection: free museum and library in London challenging perspectives on health and human experience.
- [Daily guided tours and discussions](https://wellcomecollection.org/visit-us/daily-guided-tours-and-discussions): Daily 30-minute drop-in tours and discussions with accessible options exploring health perspectives.

## Exhibitions & Galleries

- [Being Human](https://wellcomecollection.org/exhibitions/being-human): Permanent gallery exploring trust, identity and health in a changing world with interactive contemporary art.
- [Expecting: Birth, Belief and Protection](https://wellcomecollection.org/exhibitions/expecting-birth-belief-and-protection): Exhibition featuring medieval birth scroll exploring protective practices and beliefs around pregnancy and childbirth.
- [1880 THAT: Christine Sun Kim and Thomas Mader](https://wellcomecollection.org/exhibitions/1880-that): Exhibition by artists Christine Sun Kim and Thomas Mader exploring sign language and the right to communicate.
- [The Coming of Age](https://wellcomecollection.org/exhibitions/the-coming-of-age): Exhibition exploring experiences of ageing from adolescence to older age and societal adaptation for better ageing.

## Collections & Research

- [Collections](https://wellcomecollection.org/collections): Browse and search Wellcome Collection's digital archive of rare materials, manuscripts and museum collections online.
- [Discovering our Collections through E-Resources](https://wellcomecollection.org/events/discovering-our-collections-through-e-resources): Hands-on workshop teaching library research skills and digital catalogue access for collection resources.
- [Books](https://wellcomecollection.org/books): Wellcome Collection's published books exploring health, human experiences and medical humanities.

## Accessible Events & Programming

- [Handle with Care: Conversations Through Objects](https://wellcomecollection.org/events/handle-with-care-conversations-through-objects-march-2026): Drop-in accessible object-handling session with Wellcome Collection items, family-friendly and BSL interpreted.
- [BSL Tour of Being Human with Chisato Minamimura](https://wellcomecollection.org/events/bsl-tour-of-being-human-with-chisato-minamura): British Sign Language tour of Being Human exhibition with Deaf performance artist Chisato Minamimura.
- [Audio Described Tours of 1880 THAT](https://wellcomecollection.org/events/audio-described-tour-of-1880-that-christine-sun-kim-and-thomas-mader): Audio-described accessible tour of 1880 THAT exhibition by Christine Sun Kim and Thomas Mader.

## Community & Engagement

- [Get involved](https://wellcomecollection.org/get-involved): Participation opportunities including collaborative research, educational programs, and community engagement initiatives.
- [Stories](https://wellcomecollection.org/stories): Articles exploring connections between science, medicine, life and art with health narratives and cultural perspectives.

## Optional

- [Shop](https://wellcomecollection.org/visit-us/shop): Gift shop at Euston location selling books, merchandise and products inspired by collections and exhibitions.
- [A school for deaf children](https://wellcomecollection.org/stories/school-for-deaf-children): Historical article on 18th-century deaf education in England and innovative London schools for deaf children.
